case_title.quote: SHIV A KUMAR @ SHIV A @ SHIV AMURTHY v. STATE OF KARNATAKA

accused_age.correct_value: 27 at conviction; 22 at time of offence (per counsel)
accused_age.quote: on the date of conviction, the age of the appellant was 27 years
accused_age.reason: 27 is age at conviction; counsel said 22 at the offence.

accused_occupation.quote: the appellant, who was the driver
accused_occupation.reason: Accused was the driver of the company vehicle.

previous_criminal_record.quote: this was the first offence committed by the appellant

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Driver of the company vehicle in which the victim, an employee, travelled
accused_victim_relationship.quote: she was informed by the appellant, who was the driver, that the vehicle operating on route no.131 was not available
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment does describe the driver–passenger relationship.

offence_category.quote: convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 376 and 302
offence_category.reason: Omits the sexual offence and abduction.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 366, 376 and 302 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860

evidence_type.quote: her dead body was recovered at the instance of the appellant
evidence_type.reason: Recovery is the only evidence described.

confession.reason: The judgment does not say whether there was a confession; 'None' is an assertion without support.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The facts are such, which will shock the conscience of any Court.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: he had a wife and small child as well as aged parents

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced the appellant to undergo rigorous imprisonment for the rest of his life

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court, by the impugned judgment, dismissed both appeals.

final_outcome.quote: we modify the order of sentence of the Trial Court

offence_finally_established.quote: The controversy is limited to the sentence for the offence punishable under Section 302
offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions stand; only s.302 sentence changed.

imprisonment_type.quote: a fixed-term sentence for a period of thirty years must be imposed
imprisonment_type.reason: Court terms it a fixed-term sentence.

imprisonment_years.quote: released only after he completes thirty years of actual sentence

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the final sentence about the investigation resting on recovery and the last journey; the judgment does not say this.
neutral_facts.quote: Ultimately, her dead body was recovered at the instance of the appellant.
neutral_facts.reason: Rest is accurate, but the last sentence is an unsupported inference about the investigation.

offence_severity.quote: the death penalty, imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: s.302 punishable with death or life.

attempt_completion.quote: The life of the victim was cut short

physical_harm.quote: The life of the victim was cut short in this brutal manner

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The prosecution successfully established the charge of the offence of rape

post_offence_conduct.quote: her dead body was recovered at the instance of the appellant

custody_duration.quote: undergone sentence for approximately seventeen years and two months

trial_duration.reason: Dates given are accurate; others not stated.

legal_representation.quote: K. Parameshwar, Shekhar G Devasa ... for the Appellant

investigation_status.quote: The maternal uncle of the deceased lodged a complaint

appeal_history.quote: The High Court, by the impugned judgment, dismissed both appeals.

prosecution_argument.quote: the Constitutional Courts are not powerless to impose modified sentences

legal_principle_applied.quote: The fixed punishment cannot be for a period less than 14 years

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Union of India v. V. Sriharan ... followed

sentencing_rationale.quote: showing undue leniency in such a brutal case will adversely affect the public confidence

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: while considering the possibility of reformation of the accused
